annotations.title: See what the reader is looking at

description: Show what the reader is looking at now: the page open in each browser tab and the block under their pointer with the start of its text, the most recent first. Use it when the reader means what is on their screen - this page, this paragraph; for what they read before use folio_reads. It reveals the reader's screen; a hidden tab shows nothing. While the reader pauses sharing in Folio, it answers only {paused: true, message}. Answers {paused: false, looking: [{page, block: {source, id, text}, at: ISO time}]}. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.
name: folio_presence
